BiblicalUsage: Peullethai is a son of Obed-edom, named in 1 Chronicles 26:5 among the gatekeepers of the house of God, the eighth son, blessed because God had blessed Obed-edom. His father Obed-edom is the man whose house God blessed, and the blessing is the reason the sons are named as keepers of the gates.
TheologicalSignificance: I hold that the gatekeeper's son is named because the blessing on Obed-edom ran to his children, and the house of God was kept by a family God had blessed.
